Expands asset base near Key Lake Mine in Athabasca, a strategic uranium district.
Suggests potential resource scale, though not NI 43-101 compliant; may influence valuation.
Indicates mineralization quality; open to depth could add upside if confirmed.
Clean ownership path with modest royalty burden, aiding future economics.
Limits immediate valuation impact; requires twinning/infill to upgrade.

This is an early-stage expansion step aligning with the company’s exploration focus in the Athabasca Basin. A compliant resource update from twinning/infill drilling and favorable assays would turn this into a stronger catalyst.
